claim: Iteration-level scheduling enables batch membership to change across autoregressive iterations rather than remaining fixed for whole requests.
Chunked/stall-free batching addresses the throughput versus time-between-token latency interaction between long prefills and decodes.
Continuous batching does not inherently provide client fairness; VTC formalizes one fairness policy with service-difference guarantees.
SmoothQuant is a W8A8 PTQ method that addresses activation outliers via equivalent rescaling and validates accuracy empirically.
